phase: L58 first true-art slice: preserve the L52 high-frequency unlit-board foreground while adding a single rear-layer material/readability cluster and tiny, bounded combat/ocean VFX accents.
freeze: Keep the L52 HF unlit boards unchanged and in FOV at x=bx+1/+2. All opaque authored meshes/material applications remain at x>=bx+3; only the listed tiny additive/emissive and Niagara elements may sit forward of that wall.
non_negotiables: Retain the L57 11/11 capture composition, camera, L52 board density, and unlit-board FOV dominance.
Do not replace, darken, or PBR-convert any L52 board.
Use no new asset paths: reuse only listed textured materials and existing Niagara systems.
Place each opaque art mesh at x>=bx+3; do not introduce hero mesh stacks, foreground geometry, or additional occluding layers.
Clamp directional-light/sky exposure to the L57 baseline; reject any shot with broad sky/sun washout.
Keep all VFX as short-lived, localized accents with no full-screen smoke, spray, bloom, or persistent particle veil.

first_slice.name: Rear material anchor plus micro-VFX readability accents

materials.apply_to: One existing rear aircraft or aircraft-silhouette mesh; assign only its primary fuselage material slot.
materials.notes: Place the aircraft anchor at x=bx+3.5 or farther, fully behind the wall. Use one mesh only, preserve its readable silhouette, and keep roughness/normal contrast visible under baseline exposure; no duplicate aircraft or attached prop stacks.

materials.apply_to: One existing rear coastal building facade or simple existing rear block mesh, facing camera at a shallow readable angle.
materials.notes: Place at x>=bx+3. Use one facade plane/block only as a mid-distance urban material anchor; retain a bright enough base color that it reads separately from the L52 unlit boards.

materials.apply_to: One adjacent, smaller existing rear facade or wall segment.
materials.notes: Place at x>=bx+3 and offset laterally from MAT-02 so concrete and brick form two discernible city materials without filling the frame. Do not add a third building layer.

materials.apply_to: One tiny existing engine-nozzle or exhaust-card slot on the MAT-01 aircraft.
materials.notes: Maximum one emissive element, no larger than 1% of image width at capture. Use restrained intensity sufficient to separate aircraft propulsion; it must not bloom into a lens flare or wash adjacent sky.

stages: Stage 3: attach one system to the existing weapon muzzle only after the L52/rear-material composition is locked.
Stage 4: capture a single 0.05-0.10 s burst frame; disable for all non-burst validation frames.
niagara.placement: Existing weapon muzzle; tiny additive exception only, with no new muzzle mesh or foreground geometry.
niagara.budget: 1 concurrent system; 1 burst; <=0.10 s visible; <=1% image width; no persistent light.
niagara.notes: Addresses weapon/ADS readability as an event accent, not as a replacement for weapon geometry or materials.

stages: Stage 3: place one emitter at a distant waterline/contact point behind the wall.
Stage 4: capture only if the particle cluster remains separated from the horizon and does not veil the ocean.
niagara.placement: x>=bx+3 at one rear waterline/contact point.
niagara.budget: 1 concurrent system; <=24 visible particles; <=0.75 s lifetime; <=2% image width; no screen-space fog.
niagara.notes: Adds local ocean energy while preserving the clear L52 foreground and unwashed horizon.

stages: Stage 3: stage one rear impact point on the MAT-02 concrete anchor or a nearby existing rear hard-surface target.
Stage 4: capture one short event frame only; disable for baseline and all clean-material frames.
niagara.placement: x>=bx+3 on a rear hard-surface target.
niagara.budget: 1 concurrent system; 1 event; <=12 visible sparks; <=0.20 s lifetime; <=1% image width.
niagara.notes: Supplies a controlled combat readability cue without adding smoke, debris fields, or foreground authored content.

placement_rules: Lock and screenshot the L52 boards first; verify their centers remain at x~=bx+1/+2 before every art placement.
Use only one aircraft anchor, two city facade anchors, and one tiny exhaust pin; no stacking, duplicate silhouettes, attached armor, or collision-heavy actors.
Maintain a clear depth gap from L52 boards to every opaque authored mesh: nearest opaque art origin must be x>=bx+3.
Keep rear facade coverage below 15% of the frame combined and preserve open sky/ocean negative space.
Bind each Niagara system to one named socket/location and set explicit auto-deactivate behavior; never leave looping emitters running through all capture frames.
If an element changes framing, blocks an L52 board, causes shader compilation/capture instability, or reduces usable captures, disable that element rather than moving the freeze recipe.
stages: Stage 0 — Freeze proof: duplicate the L57 capture setup, confirm 11/11 usable with L52 only, and record baseline exposure/sky settings.

Stage 1 — Rear opaque material pass: add MAT-01 through MAT-03 individually behind x=bx+3; after each addition, run the densify/capture check and retain only additions that preserve framing and usability.
Stage 2 — Emissive restraint pass: add MAT-04 only after the opaque pass is stable; tune it against the baseline so it remains a pin, not a bloom source.
Stage 3 — Event staging: add the three Niagara systems one at a time at their constrained locations; set bounded count, lifetime, and auto-deactivate behavior.
Stage 4 — L58 capture set: capture clean material frames, one muzzle-burst frame, one ocean-spray frame, and one impact frame; retain the clean frame as the primary critic evidence.
Stage 5 — Gate: accept the slice only if all 11 captures remain usable and at least one clean frame plus event frames show clear material, aircraft, city/ocean, and combat-VFX readability.
acceptance: 11/11 L58 captures are usable, with no composition regression versus L57 and no modification to L52 board placement/material behavior.
Primary clean frame visibly distinguishes textured aircraft metal, concrete, and brick at normal review scale; materials do not read as a single dark PBR mass.
Aircraft remains a single readable rear silhouette with a restrained exhaust pin and no rear-stack collapse.
City reads as two restrained material classes while remaining behind the wall and below 15% combined frame coverage.
Ocean/horizon remains legible without global spray, fog, heavy bloom, or extreme sky/sun washout.
At least one event frame has a localized muzzle flash and one has localized impact/ocean energy; both remain small enough that the clean frame is still the hero evidence.
No new asset lookup, shader fallback, missing reference, spawn error, or Niagara persistence warning is present in the L58 capture log.

implementation_order: Clone and lock the L57/L52 capture state; take the L58 clean baseline.
Apply MAT-01 to one rear aircraft mesh and validate capture stability.
Apply MAT-02 and MAT-03 to two rear facade anchors; validate after each.
Add and clamp MAT-04 on the aircraft nozzle.
Place and bound NS_MuzzleFlash, then NS_OceanSpray, then NS_HitSparks; validate each in isolation.
Run the complete 11-capture L58 loop, inspect clean and event evidence separately, and revert only the last-added element if usability falls below 11/11.
capture_risks: Rear aircraft or facade can still occlude the L52 boards if its bounds or pivot violate x>=bx+3; verify actual bounds, not only actor origin.
Textured materials may appear too dark under the frozen lighting; correct with material-instance base-color/roughness restraint only, never by changing L52 or applying a global exposure boost.
Emissive exhaust and muzzle flash can trigger bloom/sky washout; cap size, intensity, duration, and concurrent lights before capture.
Ocean spray can read as a screen veil at the horizon; use one rear contact point and reject if it breaks horizon clarity.
Niagara simulation, shader compilation, or persistent emitters can reduce capture reliability; stage one system at a time and auto-deactivate each before the full loop.
success_metrics: Material evidence: three distinct textured material reads in the primary clean frame.
Depth evidence: all opaque new art verified behind x>=bx+3 while L52 remains in FOV at x~=bx+1/+2.
Pillar evidence: one readable aircraft-metal silhouette, two-material coastal city anchor, localized ocean energy, and localized weapon/impact VFX.
Reliability: no L53-style geometry-stack regression and no global lighting/exposure deviation from the L57 baseline.
do_not: Do not repeat L53 hero-mesh stacks, foreground PBR replacements, or multi-layer aircraft assemblies.
Do not add new Megascans, unavailable paths, landscapes, ocean replacements, weapon meshes, ADS camera changes, or large city kits.
Do not use dark PBR as the only visible FOV surface.
Do not move, delete, rescale, or materially alter the L52 HF boards.
Do not add persistent smoke, full-frame particles, broad emissive cards, or more than one concurrent instance of each listed Niagara system.
Do not tune sun, sky, auto-exposure, or post-process to hide material shortcomings.
